gaps.explanation: p4 (printed p31) Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds prints Debt Service and Capital Projects columns; neither has a schedule (pp8-12 are budget schedules for General, ARPA, Keno Lottery, Papillion Landing, Papio Bay) and none of their cells are in detail. Added, Debt Service: Taxes - property 3,393,826 + Taxes - city sales 509,809 + Development contribution 436,407 + Highway allocation funds 232,109 + Investment and interest income 172,661 = 4,744,812 (printed Total revenues). Capital Projects: Taxes - property 4,042,918 + Taxes - city sales 1,082,282 + Taxes - city sales additional 1/2% 5,670,645 + Licenses, permits and fees 1,152,481 + Development contribution 269,099 + City of LaVista - fire agreement 36,661 + Federal grants 156,185 + Highway allocation funds 266,811 + Investment and interest income 2,156,874 = 14,833,956 (printed). 64,676,120 + 4,744,812 + 14,833,956 = 84,254,888. Remaining difference, printed basis difference (no line to add): budgetary-basis actuals vs p4 GAAP columns: General p8 Total revenues 60,761,935 vs p4 General 46,620,795 (+14,141,140; mainly p8 Taxes - city sales 29,467,982 vs p4 15,419,848 and Investment and interest income 5,048,874 vs 5,055,083); ARPA p9 159,110 = 159,110; Keno Lottery p10 984,970 vs 992,752 (-7,782); Papillion Landing p11 2,426,697 vs 2,424,965 (+1,732); Papio Bay p12 343,408 vs 344,868 (-1,460). Net 14,133,630; 84,254,888 - 14,133,630 = 70,121,258 = p4 Total revenues. After the adds the schedule is 14,133,630 above the statement, all of it the report's own budgetary-vs-GAAP difference.
